name: gluerun-orchestration-graph
description: Read-only operator console for glueRun-go L0/L1/L2 orchestration state, deployed sub-agents, and per-task inspection from local durable records.

interface.shortDescription: Operator console for glueRun-go agents, tasks, and gates.
interface.longDescription: A read-only local console for glueRun-go orchestration: a top status/control bar (health, STOP, drift, frontier, active counts, disk, gates), a main L0 to L1 to L2 graph viewport with agents and list views, and a bottom inspector drawer that drills into any task — objective, owned and forbidden files, acceptance criteria, required evidence, lease metadata, run id, worktree existence, packets, integration audit, and task-scoped events. Deployed sub-agents are derived from durable facts only.
defaultPrompt: Show glueRun-go L0/L1/L2 status and deployed sub-agents.
